item.title: Business Model Canvas for IT Product Builders
item.description: The Business Model Canvas breaks a product into nine blocks: who you serve, what value you deliver, how you reach them, how you keep them, how you make money, what you need to build it, what you actually do, who helps you, and what it costs. I use it less as a one-time go/no-go and more as a workflow I come back to at each stage — idea, MVP, first paying customers, growth. Each stage sharpens the answers in a different block.
